title: JosephCommon
description: Shared primitive types for every Joseph contract. Money, prices and quantities are decimal strings; timestamps are UTC epoch milliseconds.

DecimalString.title: DecimalString
DecimalString.description: Exact decimal number encoded as a string. Never an IEEE-754 float.

NonNegativeDecimalString.title: NonNegativeDecimalString
NonNegativeDecimalString.description: Exact non-negative decimal number encoded as a string.

Venue.title: Venue
Venue.description: Market venue identifier: a crypto venue, a securities exchange (`twse` Taiwan Stock Exchange, `tpex` Taipei Exchange mainboard, `nasdaq`, `nyse`; `nyse` also covers NYSE Arca and NYSE American listings) or a rate publisher (`treasury`, US Treasury yield curves). `mock` is the synthetic DEMO venue and is never tradable live.

Broker.title: Broker
Broker.description: Securities broker that executes orders on exchange venues: `ibkr` (Interactive Brokers: nasdaq, nyse), `sinopac` (SinoPac Shioaji: twse, tpex), `cathay` (Cathay Securities: twse, tpex).

TradingVenue.title: TradingVenue
TradingVenue.description: Where an account trades: a crypto venue (orders go to the venue itself) or a securities broker.

CalendarId.title: CalendarId
CalendarId.description: Session calendar. `24x7` markets never close and use UTC-aligned bars. Exchange calendars align intraday bars to the session open (the last bar of a session is cut at the close), make a daily bar one session and weekly/monthly bars the sessions of an ISO week/calendar month in exchange time. XTAI: TWSE and TPEx 09:00-13:30 Asia/Taipei. XNYS: NYSE/Nasdaq 09:30-16:00 America/New_York with early closes. USBOND: US Treasury market business days 08:00-17:00 America/New_York.

MarketType.title: MarketType
MarketType.description: Product type at the venue. `stock` and `etf` are exchange-listed cash securities; `rate` is a published, non-tradable rate series (Treasury par and real yields, in percent).

InstrumentId.title: InstrumentId
InstrumentId.description: Canonical venue-scoped instrument id `{venue}:{market_type}:{venue_market_id}`, e.g. `binance:perp:BTCUSDT`, `hyperliquid:perp:BTC`, `twse:stock:2330`, `tpex:etf:00679B`, `nasdaq:etf:TLT` or `treasury:rate:UST10Y`. The same base asset on two venues is two instruments.

Timeframe.title: Timeframe
Timeframe.description: Candle resolution. Boundaries are UTC-aligned half-open intervals [start_ms, end_ms). Case matters: 1m is one minute, 1M one calendar month (starts on the 1st 00:00 UTC, 28-31 days). Seconds bars are built by the engine from the venue's public trades.

FeedState.title: FeedState
FeedState.description: Observed provenance of data shown to users. DEMO is synthetic and must never be presented as live.

HealthState.title: HealthState
HealthState.description: Health of a feed, adapter or account connection.

ZoneSide.title: ZoneSide
ZoneSide.description: Directional bias of a structure or area of interest.

ExecutionMode.title: ExecutionMode
ExecutionMode.description: Strategy activation mode. Saving a rule never implies AUTO_LIVE.

OrderMode.title: OrderMode
OrderMode.description: Mode of an individual order intent. LIVE is disabled by default and fails closed.

ErrorCode.title: ErrorCode
ErrorCode.description: Actionable machine-readable error code shown to users.

FieldError.title: FieldError
FieldError.description: Validation failure for one request field.

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description: Uniform error body for every REST endpoint.
